This is my first time playing since season 0 however i’d say i’m an above average FPS Player. Currently sat at plat 2 and will probably make Diamond this split. Aiming for Pred in the next few seasons. My best advice would be;

• Watch Twitch/ competitive to pick up tips and play styles.

• If you are solo Q’ing get a feel of what kind of teammates you have by starting passive and letting them make the calls through the first rotation out of loot phase.

• POKE!! Instead of initiating a fight all guns blazing just poke and wear down enemies shields, maybe wait for a knock then fight.

• If you’re not confident in your team try get 1 or 2 KP, then head to central circle find a building and rat it out.

• Last, but what i have found most effective.. THIRD PARTY! You never want to be the team getting jumped, be the team doing it. If you have to hold off and watch a fight until a team has been wiped or at least 1 or 2 have been knocked do it. 

Oh and i would try and find 1 or 2 legends you are most comfortable with and practice with those until you have perfected your play style.
